term.rule: lowest ID: query_type term, no filters, at least one relevant item

temporal.rule: lowest ID: query_type temporal, at least one relevant item

filtered.rule: lowest ID: query_type source_filter or sector_filter, at least one relevant item

several_evidence.rule: most relevant items in the frozen hybrid DEV top 10 (ties: lowest ID)

abstention.rule: lowest ID: drafted unanswerable, no relevant item, at least one eligible item
